title: Materials & the things they make
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · what things are made of, and the small things that fasten them · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: What is it made of?
intro.body: Six materials and six small objects. The materials answer the question a shop assistant asks you every time — what is it made of? The objects are the things that tie, fasten or hold something together.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: Materials are uncountable: cotton, wool, iron, coal — no plural, and no *a*. The objects are countable and behave normally: a rope, two ropes.
intro.note_cz: Materiály jsou nepočitatelné — bez množného čísla a bez *a*.
